query: Create a new R package for our lab's OMOP phenotype helpers with DESCRIPTION, roxygen2, NAMESPACE, a testthat skeleton, and one vignette.
add an exported fn to pkg/icuscores that computes qSOFA from a vitals tibble, with roxygen docs and an example. keep NAMESPACE in sync
Our internal package exports 40 functions and half are helpers. Help me tighten the public API, mark internals with @noRd/@keywords internal, and plan deprecations.
Move these 6 functions from scripts/utils.R into a proper R package so other analysts can install it with remotes::install_github.
roxygen keeps overwriting my hand-edited NAMESPACE and devtools::document() complains about @importFrom dplyr. fix the package docs setup
I want to deprecate `calc_egfr()` in favor of `egfr_ckdepi2021()` without breaking downstream users. Implement the lifecycle deprecation in our package.
Write a vignette for pkg/corecohort showing a cohort waterfall end-to-end, and make sure the examples in man/ match current behavior.
Should our package Import or Suggest arrow? It's only used in one export function for parquet IO. Update DESCRIPTION accordingly.
building an R package for NHANES survey-weighted helpers - need input validation at the boundaries and a sensible exported API. help me design it
Bump our package to 0.3.0 with a NEWS.md entry for the new exports and check that DESCRIPTION Authors@R and License are correct.
Run R CMD check --as-cran on pkg/icuscores and tell me if it's ready to submit to CRAN.
Write snapshot tests and mocks for the API-calling function fetch_cohort() in our package so tests don't hit the network.
Do a read-only review of the package's R/ folder for partial matching, recycling, and hidden global state; don't change anything.
Profile pkg/corecohort::build_waterfall() on 2M rows and benchmark data.table vs dplyr before changing internals.
Our package tests pass locally but fail on CI with a timezone difference in test-dates.R; diagnose the failing test.
Create a Python package with pyproject.toml for our sepsis scoring utilities, with pytest tests.
Turn analysis scripts 01_clean.R through 05_report.R into a targets pipeline with Quarto at the end.
Rewrite the join logic in scripts/merge_labs.R with dplyr and explicit relationship= arguments.
Assess whether our SAS macros library for Table 1 can be migrated to R and what the reproducibility risks are.
Commit the package changes and open a PR with a conventional title.
